sources.name: meeting-notes-2026-09-12.md
sources.text:
Payments sync – 12 Sep
Attendees: Priya, Marcus, Jo, Sam

Decision: migrate to the v3 API before the Nov 30 sunset.
Rejected Go rewrite: no one on the team maintains Go.
Cutover Nov 18, agreed by all.
Recurring: Monday sandbox reset breaks webhooks.
Priya leaves Oct 31; WH-17 needs a new owner.
